user.title: Add Onesti Lock
user.description: Select the Onesti lock to manage PIN codes for.

abort.zha_not_found: ZHA is not installed or not set up. This integration needs ZHA to decode the lock's custom Zigbee attribute reports, which tell who used the lock. Zigbee2MQTT does not expose these events in the same way.
abort.no_devices_found: No Onesti locks found in ZHA.

set_pin.title: Set PIN code
set_pin.description: Pick a slot, then enter a name and a PIN code. Slot numbers are the lock's own user slots (ZCL DoorLock), and the list starts after the master slots set under Settings. If the lock answers that it refused the code, you get an error saying why. Which answers Nimly locks actually send has not been checked on a real lock, so a refused code may still look set: try the new code on the keypad. If the lock is asleep, the first attempt times out and the integration wakes it with a lock command, which physically locks an unlocked door. Close the door before you start.

clear_pin.title: Clear PIN code
clear_pin.description: Pick the user whose PIN code to remove. Only slots with a PIN code are listed. The name stays, so remove it under Name a user slot if the slot is no longer in use. If the lock is asleep, the integration wakes it with a lock command, which physically locks an unlocked door.

name_slot.title: Name a user slot
name_slot.description: Give a slot (0-999) a name. Use it for RFID tags, fingerprints, the master codes and anything else not set through the PIN menu. Leave the name empty to remove it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Nimly PRO, Touch Pro and Code keep slots 0-2 for master codes, so choose 3. Nimly Code Pro keeps only slot 0, so choose 1. Home Assistant never writes to slot 0.

progress.set_pin_progress: Sending PIN code to the lock...
progress.clear_pin_progress: Clearing PIN code from the lock...

error.invalid_slot: Slot number must be between 0 and 999
error.lock_unreachable: Could not reach the lock. Press the keypad and try again.
error.lock_rejected: The lock refused the command (status {status}). Check the slot and the code, then try again.
error.lock_rejected_duplicate: The lock refused the code because another slot already uses it. Pick a different code.
error.lock_rejected_memory_full: The lock refused the code because its code memory is full. Clear a slot you no longer use, then try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs.

abort.no_active_slots: No active PIN codes to remove

lock_unreachable.message: Could not reach the lock. Press a button on the lock to wake it and try again.

lock_rejected.message: The lock refused the command (status {status}). Check the slot and the code, then try again.

lock_rejected_duplicate.message: The lock refused the code because another slot already uses it. Pick a different code.

lock_rejected_memory_full.message: The lock refused the code because its code memory is full. Clear a slot you no longer use, then try again.

lock_not_found_ieee.message: No Onesti lock found with IEEE {ieee}

multiple_locks.message: More than one Onesti lock is set up ({ieees}). Pick the lock with device_id, or give its ieee.

write_failed.message: Unexpected error writing to slot {slot}. See the log for details.

lock_not_in_zha.message: The lock {ieee} is not among ZHA's devices. If it was removed or its Zigbee module replaced, pair it in ZHA again. Setup is retried until the lock is back.

zha_internals.title: Lock events are not being received
zha_internals.description: Onesti Lock could not find a part of ZHA it depends on: {detail}. Setting PIN codes may still work, but the activity sensor and the onesti_lock_activity event stay silent until this is fixed. If ZHA is running and the lock is paired, a Home Assistant update has most likely changed ZHA's internals. Please open an issue on the integration's GitHub page with your Home Assistant version and this message. When ZHA starts again with the lock, the integration reconnects by itself.
